description: My name is Nicolas Augusto Paixão. I am a 9-year-old Brazilian inventor passionate about science, robotics, space and game development. I create games on Roblox. My project, Symbiocore Outpost, explores using microorganisms and tiny robots to turn human waste into useful materials for space missions. I dream of studying engineering, making Symbiocore a real technology one day and working at NASA. I participate individually with parental support.
